name: loop-manager
description: Runs a development loop with Claude Code agents: a critic turns an issue into a goal with a check a person wrote, a builder works until a hook running that check says it is met, three reviewers read the commit once, a person reviews the pull request, and an optimizer proposes one piece of guidance at the lowest rung that would have prevented the miss: a tip, a goal rule, a CLAUDE.md tenet, a skill step, or the check. Works once or paced by /loop.
